```{r}
library(reticulate)
py_require("polars")
```

```{python}
import polars as pl

kw = dict(separator="\t", null_values="\\N", quote_char=None)

basics = pl.read_csv("title.basics0.tsv.gz",
                     columns=["tconst", "titleType", "primaryTitle", "genres"], **kw)
ratings = pl.read_csv("title.ratings.tsv.gz", **kw)
principals = pl.read_csv("title.principals0.tsv.gz",
                         columns=["tconst", "nconst", "category"], **kw)

filmes = (
    basics
    .filter(pl.col("titleType") == "movie")
    .drop("titleType")
    .join(ratings, on="tconst", how="inner")
)
```

## 1.

```{python}
top5 = (
  filmes
  .sort(["averageRating", "numVotes"], descending=[True, True])
  .head(5)
)
print(top5)
```

## 2.

```{python}
genero_top = (
  filmes
  .filter(pl.col("averageRating") > 8)
  .with_columns(pl.col("genres").str.split(","))
  .explode("genres")
  .drop_nulls("genres")
  .group_by("genres")
  .agg(pl.len().alias("n_filmes"))
  .sort("n_filmes", descending=True)
  .head(1)
)
print(genero_top)
```

## 3.

```{python}
bem_avaliados = filmes.filter(pl.col("averageRating") > 7.5).select("tconst")

top_atores = (
  principals
  .filter(pl.col("category").is_in(["actor", "actress"]))
  .join(bem_avaliados, on="tconst", how="semi")
  .unique(["tconst", "nconst"])
  .group_by("nconst")
  .agg(pl.len().alias("n_filmes"))
  .sort(["n_filmes", "nconst"], descending=[True, False])
  .head(3)
)
print(top_atores)
```
